The dissociation there is between the arrival of content and its persuasive effect, formalised as distinct process stages. It licenses the stage decomposition this paper relies on, and it does not supply the person-level claim, because that programme treated the stages as loci of situational influence rather than proposing a trait at the yielding step of person evaluation. Finally, people who reason in a motivated way about moral matters often recognise that they do so and endorse it as proper reasoning (Cusimano & Lombrozo, 2023). The dissociation is between awareness and correction. The evaluator sees the motivated pattern and does not treat it as an error. It licenses the prediction that the evaluators of interest will not report themselves as biased, and it is why the gap between understanding and weighting cannot be waved away as inattention. The stages come apart. The open question is whether they come apart reliably, in the same people, whenever a person is being judged. That question defines the construct.

3. The construct and its mechanism

>The construct and its mechanism

3.1 Trait Judgmentalism

Trait Judgmentalism is a stable individual difference in the effective weighting of comprehended mitigating information during the evaluation of persons. Three commitments fix the construct. The first fixes the criterion, which is the global evaluation of the person, the verdict on what the person is, not the act's blameworthiness, the preferred sanction, or approach and avoidance, each of which can move while the verdict stands. The second fixes the input. The trait is defined over mitigation that the evaluator personally comprehends, retains and accepts as true, relevant and credible, with each of those states verified rather than presumed. The third fixes the shape, a continuous disposition, not a diagnosis, a reliable dimension of variation with a consequential upper tail rather than a categorical kind.

The second commitment carries the construct's defence against the sharpest normative objection. Under-revision is often rational. When evidence is of limited reliability, conservative updating is the appropriate response, and apparent rigidity is simply distrust of the evidence. That reading does most of its work while credibility is free to vary. Trait Judgmentalism is defined at the point where the evaluator has already conceded the mitigation's truth, relevance and credibility, and the verdict still does not move. Even there, acceptance does not fix the weight the mitigation deserves, since a conceded fact can still be weak against a confident prior, and the model comparison of Section 7 keeps conservative updating alive as a rival for exactly that reason. The trait claim is that a measurable residue remains beyond what conservatism explains, and that it keeps company with the same evaluators across occasions and targets.

3.2 Contextual Moderation Failure

The mechanism proposed for that residue is Contextual Moderation Failure, a failure of postcomprehension weighting. In the processing chain it picks out, the context is perceived, comprehended, retained, accepted as true, endorsed as relevant to the evaluation, and then given negligible weight in revising it. The failure sits after every input stage has succeeded. This is what distinguishes the mechanism from discernment. The discerning evaluator weighs the mitigation and finds it insufficient, and their verdict reflects the context having been processed through to completion. The judgmental evaluator does not get that far. The weighting step itself returns nothing, and the verdict is unchanged for a different reason, with the same outward behaviour. A theory that cannot separate these two evaluators does not deserve the name, and the separation is the paper's central measurement obligation.

The obligation can be discharged, and three discriminators are named now rather than left to the measurement stage. The first, and the primary one, is rationale coding. Asked why the verdict stands, the discerning evaluator produces reasons that engage the mitigation's content, naming what it would have had to show and why it falls short, the evidence weighed and found wanting, while the gated evaluator produces reasons that restate the verdict, the person's character re-asserted with the mitigation acknowledged and unaddressed. The second is content-generality. A discerning evaluator's threshold is bound to an evidential standard and therefore moves as the content of the mitigation moves, while the gate's flat region travels across mitigation types and targets, indifferent to what the mitigation says. The third is a registered process expectation, that discernment shows the temporal and attentional signature of weighing while the gate does not, carried as an exploratory measure rather than a criterion. Rationale coding is primary because it is observable in every design the predictions require. It remains a report of reasoning rather than a window on weighting, which is why the functional-form comparison shares primary rank in Section 7. Until these discriminators separate them, a sufficiently high-criterion dial is observationally a gate, which is exactly why the discriminators are stated here and not discovered later.

The conditions a valid test must satisfy follow directly, and they are conditions on inputs, stated in advance. The mitigating information must be perceived and attended, comprehended against a check the evaluator passes, retained at the moment of judgment, accepted as true rather than disbelieved, endorsed as relevant to the evaluation of this person, and credible on grounds the evaluator accepts. The evaluation opportunity, finally, must permit revision, with a baseline verdict recorded before the mitigation arrives.

Each condition carries an instrument and a time. The first triad, perception, comprehension and retention, is verified by checks the evaluator must pass rather than merely receive. An attention probe runs during presentation, a comprehension test paraphrases the mitigation and requires the evaluator to apply it rather than recognise it, and a retention probe is administered at the moment the post-mitigation verdict is elicited. The representation must be live when it is supposed to be weighed. The second triad, acceptance, relevance and credibility, is verified by direct affirmation. The evaluator states that the mitigation is true, that it bears on the evaluation of this person, and that its source is one they accept, with each affirmation recorded. The timing of that triad is the design's most delicate commitment. Acceptance and relevance are verified before the post-mitigation verdict is elicited, because an evaluator who sees what the mitigation implies for the verdict may withdraw relevance to protect it. The affirmations may themselves prompt revision, so their timing is counterbalanced or priced in a separate calibration arm. Post-verdict retraction of relevance is accordingly recorded as a separate outcome in its own right, since the condoned motivated reasoning of Section 2 predicts exactly that retraction, and a design that discarded retractors as failed cases would delete the behaviour it most needs to see. Pass criteria for every check are registered in advance, and cases failing any check are reported descriptively, outside the weighting analysis. Only when every condition holds does an unmoved verdict speak to the weighting step, and a null obtained with any condition unverified is descriptive, not disconfirming. That procedural discipline is what makes the mechanism falsifiable rather than a redescription of stubbornness.

The weighting failure has a shape. For most evaluators, revision is roughly proportional, more exculpatory context yielding more movement, as the updating baseline of Section 2 describes. Contextual Moderation Failure predicts a different response profile in high-trait evaluators, flat across mitigation that would move most people, then steep once mitigation passes a personal threshold and the verdict collapses all at once, the profile of a gate rather than a dial (Figure 1). The threshold metaphor does real work. It predicts that high-trait evaluators are not uniformly insensitive but discontinuously sensitive, which separates the account from simple scaling-down of everyone's updating curve, and it supplies the construct's distinctive signature of flat-then-steep revision, intact comprehension, and a flat region insensitive to deliberation prompts. In earlier statements of this framework the threshold was formalised as a computational model. That formalisation belongs to the measurement programme and is archived with it. The theory needs only the shape. Two further specifications bound the mechanism. The first is the diagnostic zone. At the floor, mitigation that is irrelevant or incredible moves nobody, and non-revision is uninformative. At the ceiling, mitigation that is overwhelming moves nearly everybody, including, the theory predicts, most high-trait evaluators, since the claim is a raised threshold rather than an absent one. The trait is therefore diagnosable only in the mid-range, where mitigation is strong enough to move most evaluators and weak enough to leave room for individual variation. This is a mechanistic restriction, not a convenience. Outside the mid-range the behaviour of the gate and the dial converge, and no design can tell them apart. Test stimuli must therefore be normed in advance to sit in that zone, and the norming itself must not smuggle the trait into the norm. Stimuli are normed on an independent sample drawn from the intended population, with the full response distribution reported, because screening normers for a trait that as yet has no validated measure would be circular. The norm will fold some unmoved evaluators into the average, a known cost, and the sensitivity analyses at alternative bands exist to price it. The diagnostic band is stated as a range, mitigation that moves roughly 70 to 90 per cent of the norming sample, fixed and registered before any test is run. The band exists to serve the mechanism, not to guarantee the construct a home.

The second is the principled non-excuser. Some evaluators hold considered positions on which whole classes of mitigation carry no weight, the retributivist for whom upbringing never excuses, the professional for whom intoxication never mitigates. Their verdicts are unmoved on principle, and the principle is doing the work comprehension-failure accounts would wrongly assign to the gate. Two tests separate principle from trait. Own-ground defeat presents mitigation that succeeds by the evaluator's own stated standard. If the verdict still does not move, the principle has been honoured and bypassed, and the failure is the evaluator's, not the doctrine's. To work it through, a retributivist for whom upbringing never excuses is given mitigation that succeeds under retributivist doctrine itself, for instance evidence that the act fails the doctrine's own culpability conditions, that the agent lacked the capacity or the fair opportunity the doctrine requires before desert attaches. The doctrine now says the verdict should move. A verdict that still does not move has been defeated on its own ground, and what remains is not principle but the gate. Domain-generality asks whether the stillness tracks the evaluator or the doctrine, since a principle is domain-bound and a trait travels. A high rate of dissolution under own-ground defeat, with apparent judgmentalism resolving into consistently applied principle, would disconfirm the construct's extension, and the paper accepts that risk by design.

4. One programme, two stages

This framework is the founding paper of a research programme, and the paper it counts as its classification-stage companion is now in print. Motivated Violation Construction proposes that, for ambiguous behaviour, motivation shapes whether an act is classified as a moral violation at all, before severity is evaluated (Boullineau, 2027). That theory began as an offshoot of the present framework. The analysis of non-revision kept colliding with an upstream question, whether the violation the verdict rests on was detected or constructed, and the classification stage proved to need a theory of its own. That stage was published first because its paper could stand alone, and the published version marks the join, situating itself within a broader interest in evaluative rigidity and noting that rigidity may sometimes operate downstream of classification, on an already moralised representation. This paper is that downstream stage. Between the two stages this programme additionally distinguishes an attribution step, the step by which an accepted act comes to define the person, treated in this paper as antecedent ground, absorbed into the moralised essentialism of Section 5, rather than as a pipeline stage of its own. The two theories divide one judgment between them. Motivated Violation Construction concerns whether behaviour enters the moral domain, and Trait Judgmentalism concerns whether the verdict on the person, once formed, responds to comprehended context. The ordering is a testable proposal of the present programme rather than an established architecture, and Section 7 states the prediction that would break it.

One terminological boundary prevents a collision. Both theories speak of thresholds. The classification threshold of Motivated Violation Construction governs whether an act is categorised as wrong, and motivation moves it before any moral verdict on the act exists, the motivation itself being a prior evaluative stance towards the actor, which is exactly why the two thresholds need separating. The revision threshold of this paper governs whether comprehended mitigation moves a verdict that already exists. Motivation can act at both, and the division is clean. Motivated construction is motivation shaping the moral input, and motivated gating, the defensive maintenance of a formed verdict against endorsed mitigation, is motivation defending the moral output, though motivation is one candidate antecedent of the revision-stage gate and not its definition, since Section 5 allows a purely structural gate. An evaluator could carry either tendency without the other, which is precisely what the programme's separability prediction requires.

5. The architecture of evaluative rigidity

The trait needs an account of where it comes from and how it shows. The architecture proposed here is deliberately spare, one core trait, two candidate antecedents, two expression channels, and a maintenance loop, each carrying its own falsifier, and all of it offered as proposal rather than settled structure (Figure 2). The first candidate antecedent is evaluative fixity, the cold face of the rigidity this architecture is named for, a structural disposition to treat person-level evaluations as settled objects rather than running estimates. Its plausible ground is moralised essentialism, the lay theory that moral character is fixed, deep and causally expressed in single acts. Essentialist descriptions of badness carry measurable downstream costs in how the described person is treated (Heiphetz, 2019), and moral traits are precisely the ones laypeople treat as most identity-defining (Strohminger & Nichols, 2014). An evaluator who represents character this way has nothing for mitigation to act on. The verdict refers to what the person is, and circumstances do not bear on essences. Cold fixity without heat has a recognisable behavioural face. Its verdicts are calm, consistent and unmoved, delivered without arousal, defended without anger, and stable across occasions because nothing emotional ever needed to subside. The essentialist belief that grounds it is measurable by existing scale, and the predicted pattern is a dissociation, with scale-measured essentialism predicting weighting failure in the revision paradigm while remaining separable from any affective measure, so that an evaluator can score high on the belief, low on reactivity, and still not move. The separating measure pairs an essentialism scale with concurrent arousal, physiological or self-reported, during the revision task. The cold antecedent predicts flat verdicts at flat arousal.

The second candidate antecedent is violation-contingent negative affect, a hot, reactive charge of disgust, contempt or anger bound to the violation representation, which makes revision aversive rather than merely unnecessary. Hot reactivity without structure has a different face. The condemnation flares at the violation and decays as the affect does, the verdict moves eventually but at a cost the evaluator visibly pays, and revision is experienced as giving something up rather than as unavailable. For this evaluator the mitigation is resisted, not inert. The weighting step is intact but aversive, and prompting, delay or affective cooling should release it. Its measure is correspondingly affective, violation-locked arousal at presentation, self-reported reluctance at the moment of revision, and entrenchment that decays as arousal subsides. The two antecedents are separable in principle, cold fixity without heat and hot reactivity without structure, and the architecture predicts their joint presence marks the consequential upper tail.

They plausibly sustain each other, affect consolidating the verdict the fixity preserves and the preserved verdict licensing the affect, a maintenance loop whose signature is temporal coupling between arousal and entrenchment. The coupling claim is operationalised as repeated measurement of affect and verdict entrenchment within evaluators across occasions, on two timescales at once. The first is minutes within an evaluative episode, as the verdict is formed, challenged and defended, and the second is weeks across episodes involving the same target. Coupling means that affect at one measurement predicts entrenchment at the next beyond what entrenchment predicts for itself, the cross-lagged increment over autoregression, and symmetrically in the other direction. The absence of that cross-lagged pattern falsifies the loop, and with it the claim that the antecedents feed each other rather than merely co-occurring.

Each element is falsifiable on its own terms. If essentialist belief fails to predict weighting failure the first antecedent falls, and if affect and entrenchment show no temporal coupling the loop falls. The core trait survives its antecedents. The architecture is a scaffold around the weighting claim, not a condition of it.

Expression is a separate fact from possession, and conflating them is the measurement mistake this paper calls the Expression Assumption, the default by which existing instruments identify judgmentalism with its overt display. The trait has two channels. The overt channel is articulated condemnation, the criticism, gossip and public verdicts that hostility and contempt measures already catch. The unvoiced channel is judgment formed, maintained and acted on without articulation, the evaluator who says nothing and quietly writes the person off. A manager is regarded by everyone as measured and fair, with no criticism, no gossip, not one negative word about a subordinate in anyone's hearing. Three years ago an employee made an error under pressure and explained it, and the explanation was accepted as true and reasonable. The employee has not been given consequential work since. Every assignment decision has been individually defensible, and the pattern is a verdict that was never spoken. Instruments built on expression are at best partial witnesses to this phenotype. Dispositional contempt comes closest, since its measure reaches private devaluation (Schriber et al., 2017), and even there the instrument indexes a standing attitude rather than a verdict's response to endorsed mitigation. Wherever expression carries social cost, the unvoiced channel should be the common one, a subsidiary and untested conjecture, and which channel a given culture or institution selects is an empirical matter the theory leaves open. The Expression Assumption is the Revision Assumption's measurement-side twin, and detecting the unvoiced phenotype requires exactly what the overt case requires, a revision paradigm rather than a display inventory, because the one thing both channels share is the unmoved verdict.

6. What Trait Judgmentalism is not

A new trait enters a crowded room, and the modern standard for admission is explicit. The construct must be a sibling of its neighbours, related but distinct, not a twin under a new name, with the direction of every validation correlation stated in advance (Lawson & Robins, 2021; Hanfstingl et al., 2025). Jangle is the disease of trait psychology, and the burden of proof sits with the new-comer. Table 1 states the full set of separations. Five neighbours carry the highest risk and earn their argument in prose. The intellectual humility family is the nearest psychometric neighbour, newly consolidated into a multi-component inventory whose defensiveness and superiority components will correlate with any rigidity construct (Pärnamets et al., 2026). The separation is one of object and of layer. Intellectual humility is about one's own beliefs and their fallibility, measured by self-report, with its cognitive and interpersonal features mapped in the measure's founding work (Leary et al., 2017). Trait Judgmentalism is about verdicts on other people, and it is defined behaviourally, at the weighting step, where self-report has no privileged access. A person can be a model of professed epistemic humility and an immovable judge of persons, and the theory predicts that dissociation rather than merely tolerating it. The separating study administers the humility inventory and the behavioural revision paradigm to one sample and tests whether verdict non-revision retains variance beyond every humility component. Dogmatism separates on process. Its established behavioural signature is reduced information seeking under uncertainty. The dogmatic reasoner declines to look (Schulz et al., 2020). The judgmental evaluator looks, comprehends, accepts, and does not weigh. One construct gates the inflow of evidence, the other gates its application. The separating study fixes information search by delivering the mitigation in full and verifying its receipt, so that dogmatic under-search is held constant while weighting varies freely.

Trait forgivingness separates on standing and temperature, though its flagship instrument reaches further than the self, covering forgiveness of self, others and situations (Thompson et al., 2005), so the standing argument must be earned rather than assumed. Forgiveness research tracks the warm, effortful resolution of a wrong. Trait Judgmentalism needs no victim role at all. Its paradigm case is the third-party verdict, where there is nothing to forgive and no resentment to resolve, and the unmoved verdict is cold. The separating study crosses victim standing with mitigation, and predicts that the weighting deficit appears undiminished in third-party cases where forgivingness has no purchase.

Actively open-minded thinking separates norm from enactment. The scale measures endorsement of the principle that beliefs should change with evidence (Stanovich & Toplak, 2026), and what endorsement predicts about behavioural revision remains an open empirical question rather than a settled identity. High-trait evaluators may well endorse the norm sincerely. The separating study is directional. Endorsement scores should predict behavioural revision weakly, and the weighting deficit should survive statistical control for them.

Moral conviction entrenches positions on issues, and more dogmatic, confident, metacognitively insensitive believers update such positions less when challenged (Decety et al., 2025). The object distinction does the work. Conviction defends propositions, judgmentalism defends verdicts on people, and an evaluator can hold weak issue convictions and immovable person verdicts. The separating study measures conviction for the issues a target's act touches, and shows that verdict non-revision generalises to targets whose acts engage none of the evaluator's convictions.

Four further boundaries earn a sentence each. Authoritarianism is an ideological content cluster whose rigidity correlates a recent adversarial collaboration finds small and heterogeneous (Bowes et al., 2026), which is precisely why Trait Judgmentalism is stated content-free and predicts nonrevision symmetrically across targets of any ideological valence. The nonjudging facet of mindfulness governs refraining from evaluating one's own ongoing experience (Baer et al., 2006), while the present construct presupposes a formed other-directed evaluation and indexes its imperviousness to warranted revision. Trait empathy and perspective-taking name the capacity and tendency to represent others' situations, and the trait proposed here begins where that capacity has succeeded. High-trait evaluators pass comprehension checks, and the failure sits after accurate representation (Eyal et al., 2018; Depow & Inzlicht, 2026). Harm-concept breadth, finally, is a validated individual difference in how much counts as harm at classification (McGrath & Haslam, 2020), kin to Motivated Violation Construction and upstream of the revision stage this construct occupies.

Compound rivals need an answer too, because a reviewer can assemble the trait from spare parts, conservatism plus negativity bias, conviction plus essentialism, low humility plus high blame intensity. Each compound reproduces a fragment of the profile and misses the conjunction. Conservatism plus negativity predicts sluggish, proportional updating, not a flat region that ends in collapse, and predicts it for beliefs generally, not persons specifically. Conviction plus essentialism predicts entrenchment where convictions live, and goes quiet for targets outside the evaluator's moral investments. Low humility plus blame intensity predicts harsh, confident verdicts, and says nothing about what happens when the evaluator personally accepts the mitigation. The full signature, comprehension intact, acceptance intact, weighting near zero, flat-then-steep, person-specific and stable, is what no compound assembles without auxiliary assumptions doing the real work. That conjunction is accordingly the critical test in Section 7, and it is appropriate to state the kill condition here, once and plainly. If the weighting deficit cannot be dissociated from general belief conservatism, or if trait variance in revision reduces to reversed forgivingness within the forgiveness cluster's own paradigms, then Trait Judgmentalism is not needed as a separate construct, and the honest response would be to retire it. That is a substantive risk, not a peripheral caveat.

7. Evidence position and predictions

The evidence position is stated without decoration. The central existence claim is untested, and this paper is theory. One piece of prior empirical work exists and its contribution is diagnostic rather than evidential. A preregistered secondary reanalysis of public blame-updating data served as a feasibility stage for this programme. Its registered prevalence hypothesis was supported, and the support turned out not to help. A second registered hypothesis, a mixture model, did not survive its sensitivity checks and is reported as such in the archived record. The registered criterion is narrower than the ordinary spread of the change scores it classifies, so it reads noise as stillness, which is also why the mixture model could not hold. On a retest trial offering no new mitigation, 81 per cent of a common cohort retained across both measurements met the same nonreduction criterion, which is what should happen when nothing new is given, and which shows that the criterion describes stillness without attributing it. The retest cohort is neither matched to nor exchangeable with the mitigated cases, so the figure sets no base rate. The dataset contains no matched within-person baseline against which an individual's non-revision could be corrected, and its scale measures blame for the act rather than the verdict on the person. The reanalysis therefore supplies no evidence for or against the trait. What it supplies is a demonstration and a requirement. The demonstration is the Revision Assumption at work in real data. The paradigm class that generated the dataset cannot distinguish an unmoved verdict from an unweighed one, which is the invisibility claim of Section 1 made concrete. The requirement, carried into every design below, is a matched within-person zero-mitigation baseline, so that each evaluator's revision is measured against their own stability rather than a group mean. The full registered record is archived and public (registration DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/Z9JKD, with the source dataset deposited by Theisen and Andow at DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/9BY25), and a numerical supplement with the frozen registration outcomes, the mapped data and a script reproducing every Stage-0 figure reported here accompanies this paper as Supplementary Stage-0 Results.

Five predictions carry the framework, each with the observation that would count against it. They are stated in words, and the procedural standard of Section 3 governs all of them. Every test verifies comprehension, acceptance and credibility with registered checks and pre-specified thresholds, every threshold the predictions require is registered before data collection and never after, and a null with a failed check is descriptive.

P1. Existence.

In designs meeting the input conditions, with mitigation normed into the registered mid-range band of Section 3, a non-trivial fraction of evaluators remain unmoved relative to their own matched baseline, and the unmoved fraction cannot be absorbed by comprehension failure, disbelief or principled bracketing. The design logic is subtraction. With every input verified and each evaluator's stability measured against their own zero-mitigation baseline, what remains of non-revision is attributable to weighting. The smallest fraction of interest is registered per paradigm before data collection, deliberately carries no universal numeric value, and an estimate below it counts against the construct. If a design capable of detecting such evaluators finds none, the trait fails and should be abandoned.

P2. Signature.

The critical conjunction. Among unmoved evaluators, comprehension checks are passed, acceptance is affirmed, and the revision profile is flat across the normed mid-range and steep beyond a personal threshold, with the flat region insensitive to deliberation prompts. The verdict on the profile requires a registered model comparison between a threshold form, a oneparameter proportional-conservatism form and a flexible smooth alternative, with the threshold form required to win by a registered margin against each, because a shape eyeballed from a curve is not a finding. Flatness itself carries a burden, defined by registered equivalence bounds rather than by a failure to detect a slope. Designs for this prediction include calibration levels above the mid-range, sitting outside the diagnostic band by design, so that the collapse limb is observable within the stimulus range. Evaluators who show no collapse within range count towards P1 but are censored for the steep limb rather than fitted to it. Proportional-but-shallow updating, or movement under prompting, disconfirms the gate and leaves conservatism standing, and a reliable non-threshold disposition would then owe its existence case to P3 and P4 on its own. The conjunction matters as a conjunction. Any one component alone is compatible with rival accounts, and only the joint pattern is the construct's fingerprint.

P3. Stability and generality.

The weighting deficit is temporally stable over retest at intervals of weeks to months, registered in advance, and travels across evaluative domains and target types. The design logic is replication across surface change, the same evaluators meeting new targets and new domains and showing the same deficit. Domain-bound stillness resolves into principle under the own-ground defeat test, and a high dissolution rate under that test disconfirms the construct's extension.

P4. Separability.

Measured against its nearest scale-bearing neighbours with preregistered directional correlations, low forgivingness, dogmatism, low intellectual humility and low actively openminded thinking, with essentialist belief measured alongside as the candidate antecedent rather than as a neighbour, the trait behaves as a sibling, not a twin, irreducible to each, with incremental prediction of verdict non-revision beyond all four jointly and beyond general personality, tested on new targets and occasions rather than on the responses that built the score. The increment must also survive two further comparators, reliability-matched conservatism in matched non-person updating tasks, which separates an evaluative trait from general updating conservatism, and the initial judgmental tendencies that first-impression measures already capture (King & Pate, 2002), which separates non-revision from harsh formation. Failure here triggers the kill condition of Section 6.

P5. Pipeline independence. The classification-side quantity is defined here as an individual's classification-threshold shift under standardised evaluative-stance induction, aggregated across stimuli and treated as a stable tendency, which is this paper's extension of the published state-level theory rather than a claim that theory makes, and it should correlate positively with the revision tendency proposed here, since both tendencies serve the maintenance of a prior stance towards the actor, while the two remain empirically separable. If the two tendencies prove indistinguishable, the two-stage architecture fails and the programme's division of labour collapses into a single construct, which the programme would then owe the field.

Three commitments govern the predictions as a set. Diagnostics are ranked. Rationale coding and the functional-form comparison are primary, while process measures, response times, attention and arousal, are exploratory, informative but never criterial. Analyses never condition on the dependent variable. Revision is never analysed only among evaluators who initially condemned, a selection the matched-baseline design forecloses by recording every evaluator's verdict trajectory from a pre-mitigation baseline. And comparisons across measures and paradigms use a prespecified common-scale estimand, each evaluator's revision expressed as a registered standardised quantity, so that cross-measure claims are claims about one number.

Validation proceeds in stages, each gated by its predecessor. The existence and signature tests come first, with the matched baseline the reanalysis made non-negotiable, then stability, the discriminant battery, and only then consequence studies linking the trait to outcomes. A behavioural revision paradigm leads throughout and self-report follows, because the construct's own architecture, Section 5's unvoiced channel and the condoned motivated reasoning of Section 2, predicts that the people of interest will not report themselves.

8. Illustrative applications

The applications that follow are illustrative and provisional. Each names a place the trait should live, and whether it does is an empirical question.

The polarisation literature has demonstrated, experimentally and at scale, that the supply of moral conflict is causally potent. Reranking partisan animosity out of live feeds reduces affective polarisation (Piccardi et al., 2025), and recent syntheses argue that the outrage-amplification lineage has mapped the situational machinery in detail (Brady & Crockett, 2024). What the literature lacks is a person-level moderator, and its own intervention results point at one. Corrections that work by revising beliefs about opponents should work least on evaluators whose verdicts do not respond to revised beliefs. Trait Judgmentalism predicts exactly that moderation, a testable claim that would connect the trait to the field's flagship paradigms. Moralisation research faces the mirror-image gap. It is rich in accounts of how practices acquire moral meaning and thin on who moralises, a gap visible in even its most recent reviews, which model process rather than persons (Zhang, 2026).

Machine evaluation offers an unexpected second habitat. Large language models now sit in judging roles, and their revision behaviour is measurably miscalibrated. On moral questions models follow helpful and harmful nudges at nearly identical rates where factual judgments show directional discrimination (Kim & Flanigan, 2026), and even when models' verdicts match human majorities, rationale-level analysis shows they reach them on divergent moral grounds, redistributing weight across considerations such as desert and the relevance of excuses (Machidon et al., 2026). These findings have not, to this programme's knowledge, been framed as what they resemble, failures of calibrated post-comprehension weighting in an evaluator. The present framework offers the vocabulary, and a parallel research line by this programme studies machine evaluators directly. The firewall stands. None of that work tests Trait Judgmentalism in people.

Organisational life supplies the quietest application. The unvoiced channel of Section 5 predicts that the most consequential judgmentalism in institutions is the kind no instrument currently detects, unspoken verdicts expressed as allocation, sponsorship and silence. Where expression carries cost, the theory conjectures that the hidden phenotype is the common one, which makes the measurement programme an organisational diagnostic in waiting.

9. Limitations and future directions

Seven limitations define the agenda. The first is that the central existence claim is untested, and the paper says so without qualification. This is a theory with a specified test, not a theory with evidence. The second is the burden of the mechanism's input conditions, which demand verified comprehension, acceptance and credibility, and building stimuli that satisfy them in the diagnostic mid-range is a substantial norming programme in its own right. The third is that the construct's self-report prospects are limited by its own architecture, and the behavioural paradigm the theory requires is costlier than the scales its neighbours enjoy. The fourth concerns equivalence across mitigation types, circumstance, mental state, pressure and repair, which is claimed only at the level of the formal prediction, with effect sizes expected to differ by type and type registered and modelled in every test. The fifth is that the two-stage architecture linking this construct to its published classification-stage companion is a proposal whose failure condition is stated, not an established structure. The sixth is that the expression channels and their cultural contingency are described, not yet operationalised, and the unvoiced phenotype will resist measurement hardest exactly where it matters most. The seventh is deliberate conservatism about consequences. The theory predicts exclusionary verdicts and their maintenance, and makes no claim about aggression or violence, where the evidence on adjacent constructs remains contested.

10. Conclusion

One claim organises this paper. There exist evaluators who understand mitigating context, accept it, and do not weigh it, and psychology's paradigms have been built in a way that cannot see them. Remove the Revision Assumption and the construct appears. Trait Judgmentalism is a stable individual difference at the weighting step of person evaluation, mechanised as Contextual Mod-eration Failure, housed in an architecture of evaluative rigidity, separable in principle from every neighbour the field currently owns, and falsifiable at five named points, with its abandonment conditions stated. The programme it founds has published its classification stage. This paper states its revision stage, and what it would take to show that the judgmental person, whom everyone knows, is real.

Figure 1. Two response profiles for the revision of a person verdict as comprehended, accepted mitigation strengthens. The dial revises in proportion. The gate is flat across the diagnostic mid-range and steep beyond a personal threshold. Outside the mid-range the two profiles converge, which is why the trait is diagnosable only inside it.

Figure2. The architecture of evaluative rigidity. Two candidate antecedents, one cold and one hot, feed a core trait of reduced post-comprehension mitigation weighting, which is expressed through an overt and an unvoiced channel. The loop between the antecedents is the proposed maintenance system, and each element carries its own falsifier.The core is the reduced post-comprehension weighting of Section 3.
